400140105.text: Oh, no way! It's the Traveler, and Paimon!

400140106.text: Ah, Traveler, welcome! Good to see you. What can I get for you?

400140107.text: We want some Black-Back Perch Stew!

400140108.text: Alright, Black-Back Perch Stew it is! Make yourselves at home, it'll be right out for you in just a moment.

400140110.text: I was just thinking about you guys, and now you're here! It feels like you heard my call and came running, tee-hee.

400140111.text: You mean, you were about to come looking for us?

400140112.text: Uh-huh, there's something I wanna discuss with you guys. Did you happen to see how the city looked on the way over here? Everyone's getting ready for the Moonchase Festival!

400140113.text: Oh, so that's what it's called.

400140114.text: Moonchase Festival? Is that another one of Liyue's ancient traditions?

400140115.text: That's right! Moonchase is a big festival where we celebrate the arrival of the fall by moonlight. The old folks say that thousands of years ago, this was the time of year when the adepti would seek the Way.

400140116.text: But it's completely different nowadays. We eat our favorite foods, spend time with friends and relatives, enjoy the moon and the flowers... so much easier. Basically, we just do all the things that people like doing and don't take a whole lot of effort.

400140117.text: Sounds like Paimon's kind of festival!

400140118.text: *chuckle* With your great taste in food, Moonchase Festival is sure to be to your liking!

400140121.text: Hey! If you've got a problem with Paimon's taste, just spit it out!

400140122.text: Um, so are you guys free these days? I'm taking part in this year's Masterful Chefs. If possible, I'd like you to be my culinary consultants!

400140123.text: That's right! Getting some suggestions from friends will broaden your horizons!

400140124.text: Masterful Chefs, huh? So is that, like, a competition?

400140125.text: Oh right, yeah, I guess you probably haven't heard about it before.

400140126.text: Every year, Moonchase Festival has a different theme — usually picked by the Qixing. This year's theme is Feast of the Bounteous Land, so the Qixing decided to organize a cooking competition.

400140127.text: Feast of the Bounteous Land... pretty much sums up what Liyue's all about. Great theme!

400140128.text: I totally agree! I heard it was Ningguang that came up with it. She's so amazing... and so full of mystery.

400140129.text: So, what do you need us to do?

400140130.text: Well, I wanna take part in the competition, but coming up with new dishes is hard work. By the time you've finally thought of something, cooked it, taste-tested it... it can be hard to judge whether you're really onto something or not.

400140131.text: So I was thinking I could get the two of you to help by gathering everyone's thoughts on what makes a great dish! I really want to think outside the box this time, and to do that I'm gonna need lots of different ideas from lots of different people.

400140132.text: #This'll be a piece of cake! We've got friends from all over the map, haven't we, {NICKNAME}?

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for some friends to chat with in the city

400140201.text: So it's outside-the-box thinking that we're looking for, right? Hu Tao always seems to have a unique perspective, so let's make this our first stop!

400140202.text: What what what? My ears are burning... did somebody say my name?

400140203.text: Aiya, it's Paimon and the Traveler! And Xiangling too!

400140205.text: Of course, Hu Tao! Way, way outside the box!

400140206.text: Meaning... you're here for some other reason, right? How might I be of assistance?

400140207.text: Well, Hu Tao, I wanted to ask you: What kind of food do you like?

400140208.text: What food I like? Hmm... off the top of my head, I don't really have an answer.

400140209.text: Wow, so even Hu Tao gets lost for words sometimes. Paimon sure didn't see that coming.

400140210.text: Come on, even the chirpiest birds clock out for the night, right? I'm no different.

400140211.text: Pretty sure "clocking out" isn't something birds do, but okay...

400140212.text: It's okay, Hu Tao, just keep it simple.

400140213.text: Right! There's no need to over complicate it, just pick a dish and tell me what you like about it! I'm doing some market research.

400140214.text: I see, I see! Launching a new dish? Well, let me say right off the bat — nothing weird, okay! Some poached fish, a side of shrimp dumplings, that's all you need!

400140215.text: Poached fish and shrimp dumplings? That's a bit ordinary, isn't it?

400140216.text: Well, it is and it isn't. Think about it, poached fish is hot and spicy with a powerful aroma. It's a "dynamic" dish. Add a side of shrimp dumplings, and there's your "static" component. Got it?

400140218.text: Oh, oh.... I—I can do dynamic! Mushroom Slime Stew—

400140219.text: Not that kind of dynamic! A dish is more than substance, it's a mood. Poached fish is red and spicy. It elicits a response from the eyes, ears, nose, and mouth. That's why I call it "dynamic."

400140220.text: Shrimp dumplings are more subdued — clear and smooth with a pure and subtle fragrance. I call that "static." Combining dynamic and static is how you create a perfectly balanced meal, a union between opposite but complementary features co-existing in perfect harmony!

400140221.text: Paimon didn't follow that at all... but at the same time, it kinda sounded smart, so...

400140222.text: Okay... dynamic and static, opposite but complementary...

400140223.text: Um, is this just another way of saying you should keep everything balanced? Y'know, a little meat, a little veggie? A little salt, a little sugar?

400140224.text: Bingo! Except, I don't think you need to have a sweet dish for it to be a complete meal. Personally, I always skip dessert.

400140225.text: Okay, I think I got it! At first, I thought you were just goofing around, but actually you make a really good point!

400140226.text: Hee-hee, how did I ever doubt you, Hu Tao! Thanks!

400140227.text: When it comes to telling tales, the storytellers have got nothing on Hu Tao.

400140228.text: Hmm? Sounds suspiciously like a compliment to me. I'll take it!

400140230.text: Aha! Well, at least one of you gets it!

400140231.text: Everything in this world runs on its own set of principles, be it the circle of life or sugar and spice! You either get it or you don't.

400140232.text: Since the Traveler seems to approve, I'll make sure to factor it in.

400140233.text: Paimon thinks we're pretty much done here now. Let's head to Bubu Pharmacy next.

400140234.text: Bubu Pharmacy... Yeah, you'll definitely get some interesting responses over there. Hehehe...

400140401.text: Oh, it's you. Is everything okay?

400140402.text: Why, if it isn't the special guests who seldom visit. Less busy than usual, I see.

400140403.text: Yikes, wh—what happened to Baizhu's voice!?

400140407.text: Haha, welcome, welcome. Here to procure an herbal remedy, I presume?

400140408.text: No no, we actually came for the conversation this time. We're here to talk food!

400140409.text: I'm entering this year's cooking competition, so I wanted to ask you both... wait, there's three of you! I wanted to ask the three of you about what kind of food you like.

400140410.text: Hahaha, most astutely self-corrected. We shall surely supply our assistance.

400140411.text: You need to know... what food I like? Hmm...

400140412.text: It's all the same. No flavor.

400140413.text: Qiqi has some gustatory dysfunction and can't taste any food. Make no mistake, she's not being uncooperative.

400140414.text: Oh, I understand, that's fine! Still, I'd expect Qiqi to have some sort of dietary preferences, though. There must be some dishes that you like the sensation of?

400140417.text: Well that doesn't help us. It's not a dish, it's a drink...

400140418.text: How about you two? Any thoughts?

400140419.text: I like bite-sized morsels of meat.

400140421.text: Many of our patients are the elderly and young children. They find large chunks of Fowl or seafood difficult to swallow and digest. Dishes where the ingredients have been finely chopped, on the other hand, are far more suitable for them.

400140422.text: We also see plenty of people with colds and sore throats who find it difficult to eat rich food... From a purely pharmaceutical perspective, I tend to recommend soups and stews.

400140423.text: Got it. Would that be medicinal soups and stews?

400140424.text: Whew, medicinal soup... I don't like it.

400140425.text: I must apologize for having such a one-track mind... It's a little difficult to think about food without worrying about the health implications these days. We've had quite the endless stream of patients recently... If you ask me, I think the changing weather is to blame.

400140426.text: That's okay, everyone's input counts. Keeping it seasonal and suitable for all ages sounds like a pretty good idea to Paimon.

400140428.text: Medicinal dishes have higher demands in terms of nutritional balance than the kind of food I normally cook. I don't usually focus on medicinal properties, but since this is for a competition... maybe I can score more points by taking both flavor and function into account.

400140429.text: Food with substance, always better. Everyone will like it.

400140430.text: It's a great suggestion! Thanks everyone!

400140431.text: You're welcome. As long as we could help.

400140432.text: It's great to have a doctor's unique perspective. I'm feeling inspired!

400140434.text: Receptivity to sensible suggestions makes for a savvy chef.

400140435.text: Oh, she is! Creating new dishes is Xiangling's favorite thing to do, you can be sure she'll put lots of care and attention into it!

400140436.text: Hee-hee... Everyone's got their hobbies, and mine is cooking! Usually, I just go with my own ideas, but having a whole new perspective this time is sure to make a big difference to the end result.

400140437.text: Great! That makes this whole trip worth it.

400140438.text: Alright, time to move on to the next! So we've got an independent thinker's perspective and a health perspective... Next, Paimon thinks we should probably talk to some picky eaters.

400140501.text: Hmm? Oh, it's the Traveler and Paimon... and Xiangling.

400140502.text: Greetings, friends. It's been a while.

400140506.text: What's with this great big stone on the ground?

400140507.text: Long story... So, just to confirm, I will assume responsibility for handling this stone of unknown origin. Any objections?

400140508.text: None here. You know how to get things done, Keqing. As long as it's with you, I can rest easy knowing that it's in safe hands.

400140509.text: Should I take this to mean that you doubt the relative safety of leaving this in the hands of the Tianquan?

400140510.text: Huh? Well, for starters, Keqing is the one who's always out running errands, rain or shine. Besides, you don't seem to give a wooden Mora about this whole thing anyway, so what's it to you!

400140511.text: I was merely joking. You, meanwhile, seem only too ready to pounce when an opportunity to publicly lambaste me arises, even when it means giving our poor mutual friend here the cold shoulder.

400140512.text: Uh... Is this a bad time?

400140513.text: By no means. You wish to know about the stone, I presume? Then let me invite the great seafarer, Captain Beidou, to tell the story — if she would be so kind.

400140515.text: Well... It's a big one, right? And such a smooth surface, too. Makes you think there's gotta be a good chunk of jade in there.

400140516.text: It was found by a fishing crew not far off the coast. It must have been underwater for years, so the erosion will be what's given it that smooth finish.

400140517.text: Finds like this cannot be kept as private property, and must be submitted to a holder of public office. Placing it into our custody will also give them peace of mind.

400140519.text: Well, we've hit it with just about every weapon we could get our hands on and haven't managed to even dent it yet. Clearly, there's more to it than meets the eye.

400140520.text: No weapon could smash it open? Wow... Paimon doesn't think we've ever encountered a stone like that before...

400140521.text: Keqing has taken an unusually keen interest in this giant stone, which is why we are leaving the matter in her capable hands.

400140522.text: Let's put that aside for a second. Traveler, what brings you here? Were you looking for someone?

400140523.text: Actually, we were looking for all of you! We need all hands on deck here!

400140524.text: Oh? Hopefully not because there's been some sort of cataclysmic event?

400140525.text: No no, nothing like that! Paimon's just getting carried away... I just wanted to ask everyone about their food preferences.

400140527.text: I have rather simple tastes. Precise, pure, smart, and sophisticated. That is all I require.

400140528.text: That's your idea of simple, huh?

400140529.text: I summed up my culinary requirements in four words. Is that insufficiently simple for you?

400140530.text: A few weeks out on the open ocean would fix your flawed definition of simplicity, let me tell you that.

400140532.text: Me? Uh... if it's freshly cooked and piping hot, that floats my boat. If it's got a little chili pepper in there too, I'm one very happy Captain.

400140533.text: Paimon thought you would've said bar food.

400140534.text: Hahaha, oh, bar food works too!

400140535.text: As for me... it's got to be seafood.

400140536.text: Okay, got it! So, seafood, piping hot, and, uh, simple-but-sophisticated...

400140538.text: That's where I would disagree! Traveler, surely you've heard of Golden Shrimp Balls?

400140540.text: You need to wash and de-vein the shrimp, wrap it in finely sliced potato strips, then deep fry it to perfection. There's no room for cutting corners!

400140541.text: They're very precisely put together, they taste pure, the presentation is smart, and the skill needed to cook them is highly sophisticated... It fits Ningguang's four-word summary to the letter!

400140542.text: Huh, so what you're saying is... for all the frills and trills, good food is all the same at the core?

400140543.text: I heartily agree. Golden Shrimp Balls are a prime example. Their essence lies in combining art and nutrition in a single package. It is a dish of true value.

400140544.text: Okay, got it — so, Keqing loves Golden Shrimp Balls...

400140546.text: Hahaha, no, at least not outright.

400140547.text: Alrighty! Thanks for all of your input! I'll be sure to take it all into consideration!

400140548.text: Traveler, Paimon, do you have anything planned after this?

400140550.text: Good. I'd like you to help me investigate something. It's about this stone...

400140551.text: You picked the right people for the job. We investigate stuff all the time!

400140552.text: My thoughts exactly. The Qixing has a public duty to deliver our final verdict to the fisherman, but there are also some things I would like to investigate on a personal level.

400140553.text: I'm sure you've become acquainted with the general background of the Moonchase Festival. However, I have my own understanding of this festival's roots.

400140554.text: My grandfather was a researcher of Liyue's traditions. In his notes, he indicated that there was a deity called the Stove God in ancient Liyue which people paid tribute to at a certain time of the year.

400140555.text: Very few written records make mention of the Stove God, and those that do are notoriously confusing. Some scholars believe that the Stove God was just another title held by the Lord of Geo, but others suggest that this was a different deity altogether...

400140556.text: One folktale even claims that the ancients found the Stove God's shrine, but there was no statue — only a huge, smooth slab of stone.

400140557.text: Shortly after it was found, the stone was lost in transit, and it hasn't been seen since. This stone here has all the same features, so I suspect it could be the one that went missing all those years ago.

400140558.text: After many years of researching ancient texts, my grandfather came to believe that the practice of paying seasonal tribute to the Stove God may be best described as a festival — he called it the Stove God Festival. That would make it the forerunner to the Moonchase Festival we know today.

400140559.text: But this is all just theory and conjecture. To prove any of it, we'd need to start by identifying who the Stove God really was.

400140560.text: Now that Rex Lapis has passed on and Liyue has entered the age of humankind, his successors should continue to respect our nation's culture and traditions, just as he did.

400140561.text: That's why I think the responsibility for this situation should fall to me. It's a chance to shed light on our history, revitalize an ancient tradition, and possibly prove my grandfather's hypothesis along the way. With any luck, we'll nail all three in one fell swoop.

400140562.text: It was just a couple of days ago that we received this stone — right after we decided to use food as the central theme for this year's festival. It makes me wonder... maybe a divine will is at work behind all of this.

400140563.text: Three birds with one stone, huh? That's pretty efficient — even for Keqing!

400140565.text: I'm in the middle of a commission for Xiangling...

400140566.text: Hey, don't worry about that. This sounds super important, so don't mind me.

400140567.text: Besides, we were only... Hmm? Wait a second... I got it!!!

400140569.text: Keqing, can I tag along for your investigation?

400140571.text: Since it's all about the Stove God, I might get to learn something useful about cooking along the way. It'll be great inspiration for me in the competition!

400140572.text: Please? Lemme come along. I promise I'll help!

400140573.text: If it means that much to you... Okay, I suppose you can come.

400140574.text: Really!? Yay, thank you so much! You're the best!

400140575.text: Ahem! Now that that's settled... Time to get going. Qingce Village is said to be home to a lot of historical texts, so I'd like to start by making some inquiries there.

400140576.text: Alright, then it's off to Qingce we go!

400140301.text: Hi granny, we need your help with something!

400140302.text: Are there any old books around in Qingce Village? You know, from a really long time ago.

400140303.text: Oh, looking for ancient texts, are we? Let me think...

400140304.text: There is an old warehouse over there, property of the Feiyun Commerce Guild. Many books are stored inside — those that they have no room for at home. In fact, their youngest comes over this way to read sometimes.

400140305.text: The Feiyun Commerce Guild's youngest? You must be talking about Xingqiu.

400140306.text: Hmm... Paimon didn't know they had a warehouse here. Let's go take a look!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Feiyun Commerce Guild warehouse

400141504.text: Sorry to interrupt your conversation... I was in the area buying a few things and I heard the disturbance, so I felt compelled to come take a look...

400141505.text: You mean Cloud Retainer? I saw her too. She just suddenly showed up right in the middle of the street... Whatever adeptal power that was, she certainly knows how to make an entrance.

400141506.text: Lady Keqing, you saw her too? ...Ahh!!!

400141507.text: Do you, uh, have a moment? I need to... discuss something with you.

400141508.text: What is it, Ganyu? Has something urgent come up while I've been out?

400141509.text: No, it's nothing work-related. I wanted to ask about... um, something personal. Is that okay?

400141510.text: (A personal matter... involving me? Surely I haven't done anything improper recently, have I?)

400141511.text: Please, Lady Keqing? This is really important to me...

400141513.text: I noticed Cloud Retainer was here for quite a while. Did she say anything about... m—me? When I was young?

400141514.text: About your childhood? No, nothing at all.

400141516.text: I was getting really worried... Once she gets talking to people, she tends to go off on all sorts of tangents... so I was worried she might have bored you with some stories about me, heh...

400141517.text: Your name didn't even come up. So you've nothing to worry about.

400141518.text: Keqing, how are you not asking a bunch of questions right now? There's obviously some juicy gossip here, aren't you curious to find out what it is?

400141519.text: Ah! P—Please, no, don't do that to me...

400141520.text: Of course not. Whatever it is, I'm not curious, and I'm not going to ask.

400141521.text: If Ganyu has a secret and she wishes to keep it that way, nobody should make it their business to try and get it out of her. That's just basic decency, is it not?

400141522.text: Y—Yes, Ma'am... Paimon'll never bring it up again...

400141524.text: Thank you. You're so kind and considerate... I've always seen that in you.

400141525.text: Wh—What's that got to do with... Honestly. Go on, you should be getting back now.

400141526.text: Oh my, you're right, I should. Okay everyone, please excuse me, I should get back to work now. Take good care of Keqing for me.

400141527.text: Hey! What are you trying to say!?

400141528.text: Aw, don't worry, Ganyu, we will!

400141529.text: Thanks. Hope to see you again soon.

400141530.text: At the end there, she sounded like your big sister.

400141532.text: Hey everyone! I just had an idea!

400141533.text: It only occurred to me when that adeptus showed up. Do you think the Stove God could be an adeptus too?

400141535.text: I don't want to assert either way... but it seems highly likely.

400141536.text: In that case, we should go ask the adepti about it. I think my master might be able to help.

400141537.text: Master? You mean, your teacher is an adeptus?

400141538.text: Uh-huh, she's over at Yujing Terrace. C'mon, I'll introduce you!

400140902.text: Ugh... I've come here to clean the book warehouse plenty of times before, but this is the first time I've run into these crooks...

400140904.text: I am, thanks to all of you. Hey, wait a minute — you're the Traveler, aren't you? And you're with... Lady Keqing! An honor, truly an honor!

400140905.text: We'll try not to take up too much of your time. I understand that this book warehouse is the property of the Feiyun Commerce Guild? Could you advise whether we might find any texts relating to the Stove God in this collection?

400140906.text: The Stove God? Uh... I heard that's the Lord of Geo, right?

400140908.text: Yeah, a friend of mine who conducts research mentioned it once before. We use stoves for cooking, and stoves are built from rock.

400140909.text: Some people think that the stove is a gift from the Lord of Geo, and that's why they call him the Stove God.

400140911.text: But do you have any books on the topic?

400140912.text: Um... I, uh... I'm sorry, I'd have to ask the young master about that...

400140916.text: Hey guys, what are you doing here?

400140917.text: I was bored with nothing to do and thought I'd come out this way for a bit of reading. And then I thought, why not bring Chongyun along, too.

400140918.text: Yes, I'm just along for the ride really...

400140919.text: I see the Yuheng, Keqing, is with you. Whatever brings you here must surely be a matter of grave importance.

400140920.text: Master Xingqiu, if I may be so bold — do you happen to know if there are any texts on the subject of the Stove God among this collection?

400140921.text: Since I personally selected which volumes to store here, I do have some recollection of their contents.

400140922.text: If my memory betrays me not, there is one volume among them called "Demystifying the Legends of Liyue," which mentions the Stove God.

400140924.text: Certainly. If it pleases my lady, I shall lead the way. Sheng, I will take care of things here. You're free to go about your own business.

400140925.text: They're back! So, did you find it?

400140926.text: Yes. Master Xingqiu has quite an exceptional memory, "Demystifying the Legends of Liyue" does indeed mention the Stove God. However...

400140927.text: It says the following: "The body of the dragon wielded a tail that could eclipse the sun, and claws to command fire and teach the ways of wisdom. Receiving the gift bequeathed unto them, humankind cooked food with fire, and thus did they prosper."

400140928.text: The body of a dragon? The stories about Rex Lapis say the same thing.

400140929.text: That much is true. But this is the only passage in the whole book. If we want to find out more, we'll have to continue our investigation.

400140930.text: There's nothing further to discover here. It seems we'll have to look at other options.

400140931.text: I come from a long lineage of exorcists, and our family too has amassed a number of ancient texts. Now that you mention the Stove God, I seem to recall reading somewhere that this god once appeared at the Guili Assembly. Of course, I can't say if it's true or not.

400140932.text: Books are penned by people. All they can do is show what the author was thinking. Everyone's mind is different, so every book on a given topic will give a different account.

400140933.text: I apologize that we could not help in a more substantial capacity.

400140934.text: Your help thus far is quite ample. Liyue is a vast and rich land, all things that existed here in the past have left their trace. So long as we do not abandon our search, it is sure to bear fruit eventually.

400140935.text: Thank you all. We will continue our investigation elsewhere.

400140936.text: Ah, hold up! I had a question too! Xingqiu, Chongyun, could you tell me what kind of food you like?

400140937.text: Food? Oh no... Y—You're not thinking of taking part in Masterful Chefs, are you!?

400140938.text: Uh, yeah, I totally am! What's wrong... You look like you've just seen a ghost!

400140939.text: Xiangling, this is a major event. I beg you, please don't cook anything strange for this competition...

400140941.text: Mushroom Slime Stew, to give one example.

400140942.text: Okay, fair enough, that dish isn't my most popular... but that's why I'm doing all this research, so I can create some really special dishes to win everyone over.

400140943.text: Well, in that case... I like cold food.

400140944.text: That's 'cause you can't handle hot and spicy, right?

400140946.text: My tastes are on the mild side — I prefer gentle dishes with minimal seasoning. Soups and stews, vegetables in broth, seafood or freshwater fish, either boiled or steamed... These kinds of dishes I am most partial to.

400140948.text: Okay, another mild child... Got it.

400140949.text: These are just personal preferences, and everyone's are quite different... Are you sure this eclectic mix of opinions will be of any use?

400140950.text: Of course! You're my customers, and putting a smile on customers' faces is my calling as a chef!

400140951.text: Though Xiangling's market research blade stabs often into the dark, her heart never strays from the noble path.

400140952.text: If anyone can win hearts and minds with their cooking, it's gotta be someone like Xiangling. She's got pure intentions and really cares about the customers.

400140953.text: Where's all this praise coming from...? Knock it off guys, you're embarrassing me...

400140954.text: Ah! Sorry for holding you all up — that's all I needed to know! Shall we carry on with the investigation now?

400140955.text: Over to you, Keqing. Where to next?

400140957.text: So we've learned the Stove God allegedly made an appearance at the Guili Assembly. But today, that place is largely a wasteland, with few traces of human activity.

400140958.text: Wangshu Inn is close by, so let's stop off there on the way over and see what we can find out.

400140959.text: Forgive us, for this is where we must part ways. May your journey be a smooth one.

400140960.text: Yes, best of luck! If you run into any difficulties, come and find us. We'll be only too glad to help!

400140962.text: Let's go! Next stop, Wangshu Inn!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Wangshu Inn and look for Smiley Yanxiao

400141001.text: Huh? Oh, Traveler. Who are all these people?

400141002.text: Friends of ours. Allow Paimon to introduce Xiangling, Guoba, and Keqing.

400141003.text: Keqing? Of the Qixing!? She's the, um... the, uh...

400141005.text: No need to be so nervous, Yanxiao.

400141006.text: It's not that, it's... I mean, I'm just your typical commoner, I've never met someone as high up as the Yuheng before in my whole life!

400141007.text: (Look at that strong body, those powerful hands, and honest eyes... this guy must be a really great chef!)

400141008.text: So, is there something I can help you with? You've come a long way out to end up at Wangshu Inn.

400141011.text: Legends claim that the Stove God once appeared at the Guili Assembly. As Wangshu Inn is the oldest extant building in this area, any historical texts from around these parts are likely to have ended up here.

400141012.text: Is there a room in this inn for storing books? And if there is, do any of them mention the Stove God?

400141013.text: Now that you mention it, we do have a fair few ancient texts here. I remember looking through an old recipe book once... I just need to remember where they're all stored.

400141014.text: If you're happy to wait here for a few minutes, I'll go have a look right away!

400141015.text: Oh, Traveler, there's something I need to discuss with you.

400141016.text: What is it? We need to pay up or something?

400141017.text: What? No, I wouldn't take your money! We're all friends here. I just wanted to ask if you had the time to make a Satisfying Salad for me?

400141021.text: Guy who hangs out on the roof terrace, you know? Good looking fella, not too tall...

400141022.text: Shh! Don't you think he can hear you!?

400141023.text: Oh, right! Uh, yeah, maybe. Anyway, you know who I mean.

400141024.text: The boss told me to take care of him, but this guy, let me tell you — he is one tough nut to crack. He usually turns his nose up at everything that isn't Almond Tofu.

400141025.text: But the boss tells me you once made him a Satisfying Salad and it all went down so well. So I was thinking... Could you teach me how to make it too? That way, I'll have something else in my arsenal.

400141026.text: Oh, so this is for Xiao! You guys really look after him, huh.

400141027.text: Well, that's life, right? You've gotta look out for your own people.

400141202.text: Alright, thanks for that. I think I've got it now.

400141203.text: You got all the steps down, right?

400141204.text: Of course. Don't forget, I am the best chef around these parts.

400141205.text: Let's go see what Keqing and Xiangling are up to.

400141207.text: You've finished cooking? Good timing, we've finished our reading, too.

400141209.text: Useful. There is a passage concerning the Stove God, and it's not what we were expecting.

400141210.text: I quote: "60 miles to the northwest is the Guili Assembly. Many were settled there, where they hunted in groups, farmed the land, and made their living from what the soil yielded."

400141211.text: "When the Stove God descended, one god became many, all of which were the height of children. As does a star when it descends into the world, so the Stove God went out among the common folk and taught them to create fire. With fire, the people at last learned to make hot food, and they dined on rice congee and cooked meat thereafter."

400141212.text: This is a radically different account from the one given in "Demystifying the Legends of Liyue," and also a conflicting one.

400141213.text: "One god became many"... Does that mean there was more than one Stove God?

400141214.text: Taking the text at face value, that is what it says.

400141215.text: "Went out among the common folk and taught them to create fire"... So, did the Stove God really go and teach people how to cook firsthand?

400141216.text: Now that's a god who truly cared for their people.

400141217.text: So we've got two leads, but they contradict each other. How do we know which one to believe?

400141218.text: By continuing with our investigation, and reserving judgment for now.

400141219.text: Thank you for this text, Yanxiao.

400141220.text: It's my pleasure, really. Think nothing of it. If anything, I should be thanking the Traveler.

400141221.text: Listen, you've helped me an awful lot — not just today but in the past, too. I wanna make it up to you properly, and as it happens, things are pretty quiet here today. So I'd like to take the chance to treat you all. What do you say — will you stay for a meal?

400141222.text: Wow, he sure sounds confident in his cooking! I like that — confidence is one of the best ingredients a chef can have!

400141223.text: I really wanna try his cooking. I say we take him up on his offer!

400141224.text: Keqing, can you spare the time?

400141225.text: It's hard to refuse a generous offer like that... Yes, I think we can fit this in.

400141226.text: Yanxiao, we await your culinary creations with great anticipation.

400142102.text: You'd think you own the place.

400142105.text: Here we are. That's everything you ordered.

400142107.text: (It all smells amazing... I think I've met my fellow finalist!)

400142109.text: Strange, I never would have guessed that such a gifted chef worked here. This inn isn't particularly known for its food.

400142110.text: Everyone likes a good meal, whether they're staying the night or just stopping by for a bite. We call it an inn, but the fact is, it's much more than that. We have to cater to all aspects of daily life to make this a true home away from home.

400142111.text: Please enjoy your meal at your leisure. I should get back to work now.

400142112.text: Yanxiao... are you taking part in this year's Masterful Chefs?

400142115.text: Yep, I've signed up already, and I've got my eyes on the prize! Your cooking's delicious, Yanxiao. I'm really looking forward to seeing you in the final!

400142116.text: Hah... interesting. Alright, I'll see you there!

400142117.text: What was that? Some kind of power move?

400142118.text: No, it seemed more sportsmanlike than that.

400142119.text: Yep! He's a really talented chef. His food was excellent, and it showed he has a level-headed personality. That's the kind of chef that could be a match for me.

400142120.text: I haven't had any competitive cooking experience since my cook-off with Brook in Springvale.

400142121.text: When the heat is on, you'll rise to the challenge!

400142122.text: You're too kind... Ah!!! Guoba, what are you doing!?

400142125.text: Those were Keqing's! How could you steal them while she wasn't looking!?

400142129.text: You ate every last one... *sigh* Guoba, we've been through this. When we're with friends, you gotta be on your best behavior, okay?

400142130.text: I'm so sorry, Keqing, I promise I'll make it up to you!

400142131.text: What's the big deal? We can just get another plate. After all, it's Yanxiao's treat today.

400142132.text: It's not the same, though! The moment's gone. Sure, you can eat something else, but you can never go back and change that feeling of despair as your food is snatched away from right under your nose...

400142133.text: The dining experience is a trinity of emotion, food, and atmosphere, and you've gotta have all three to make it work!

400142134.text: I have to say, now that you mention it, that is a very accurate appraisal of the situation...

400142135.text: I'm gonna make it up to you, Keqing. Is there anything you wanna eat? Anything at all! Whatever it is, I'll make it for you!

400142137.text: (I don't have high hopes for this, but equally I don't want her feeling guilty... Okay, I'll let her do this for me.)

400142138.text: If you insist, there is one dish that perhaps you could try making for me. It's an old recipe from my grandfather's notes.

400142139.text: No problem. May I see it?

400142140.text: I'll get it to you when we're back in Liyue Harbor.

400142143.text: Before we do anything else, let's head back to Liyue Harbor. I need to fetch something.

400142201.text: I need to go home to fetch my grandfather's notes. Let's meet at Wanmin Restaurant later.

400142203.text: I'll go get everything ready! Traveler, what about you? Are you gonna do your own thing for a while, or do you wanna come in and have a seat?

400142204.text: #I actually have something to discuss with {F#her}{M#him}. You go ahead, we'll join you later.

400142206.text: Traveler, come here for a moment.

400142207.text: I need your advice on something... What do I need to do to get along with Xiangling?

400142210.text: What's so strange about it? Why are you looking at me like that...?

400142211.text: You're super smart and you're always so sure of yourself. Paimon thought you'd never need advice from anyone about anything.

400142213.text: Xiangling's always so warm and friendly with me, this time especially, and now she's desperate to do me a favor... So is that supposed to mean... uh, we're friends already?

400142214.text: I'm just not used to dealing with people who are so warm right from the get-go. How exactly am I supposed to respond to that?

400142219.text: Ahem! Noted. Thank you, Traveler, I'll see you again shortly.

400142220.text: What's making Keqing so self-conscious? Paimon thought nobody would be able to get under her skin.

400142221.text: I'd like to hear what Xiangling thinks.

400141402.text: Hey, grab a seat. I'm just running through my ingredients to see what I'm missing.

400141403.text: Xiangling, can I ask you a question?

400141404.text: Oh... we're gonna do this now?

400141407.text: But this was your idea! Why you gotta dump it on Paimon!? Urgh...

400141408.text: Okay, so, back at Wangshu Inn, we noticed you and Keqing were getting along pretty well. So you really like hanging out with her, huh?

400141409.text: Yep! Keqing's good-natured and easy to be around. The kind of person everyone wants to know, right?

400141410.text: You're a braver person than Paimon... The first time we met Keqing, Paimon found her pretty intimidating...

400141411.text: She does have a formidable presence.

400141412.text: You think so? I remember thinking straight away that she was really easy to get along with. Didn't you see her sneaking treats to Guoba back at Wangshu Inn?

400141413.text: Yeah, she's great, we know that now! We're just talking about first impressions.

400141414.text: First impressions? Oh, okay — Hey, have you guys eaten grilled shellfish before? They can be hard to crack at first. But they taste amazing that way.

400141415.text: We've eaten shellfish before, but... nope, don't think we've tried eating them grilled.

400141416.text: Oh, you're missing out! I'll grill some for you another time. But anyway, Keqing's like a shellfish. Maybe a little closed-off at first, but once you get to know her, she's got a soft and squishy side, too!

400141417.text: Not to mention that even after her favorite food was stolen away, she was still happy looking after Guoba. I'm really grateful for that.

400141419.text: #You know, {NICKNAME}, Xiangling's intuition for people seems really spot-on. Is that why she took a liking to Keqing so quickly?

400141421.text: Alright, let's see... We're okay for Carrots and Crab, and we still got some Ham and Mushrooms... Hmm, I wonder what Keqing's recipe is gonna be?

400141424.text: What the! That bird is huge!

400141426.text: Excuse me! One shall not be addressed in such a manner!

400141427.text: One shall be known as an adeptus, whose name, should you care to mention it, is Cloud Retainer.

400141428.text: Cloud Retainer... that does sound like an adeptus name.

400141429.text: Well spoken. One shall let this young lady's enlightened words atone for the ignorant ones of her friend.

400141431.text: A while it has indeed been, Traveler. Does one surmise correctly that you hasten hither to partake in the Moonchase Festival?

400141432.text: You could put it like that, yeah...

400141433.text: Ah so, even the illustrious Traveler has been summoned to attend the Moonchase Festival. As expected, this year's theme stands proud against the test of public scrutiny.

400141434.text: The theme? You mean "Feast of the Bounteous Land"?

400141435.text: The very same. Moonchase Festival falls during the season when many cooking ingredients are ripe, hence it is a fitting time to enjoy the finest of foods. One noticed the relative pomp and ceremony with which this year's affairs are being conducted, and could not abide to stand idly by.

400141436.text: Let it be known that one's culinary proficiency and ingenuity is uncontested in all the world! Thus does one now appear in this realm, that those who inhabit it might witness one's latest creation: a supreme cuisine machine.

400141440.text: Patience! One's purpose here today is to meet and to greet, nothing further. All shall be revealed before your very eyes when the time arrives.

400141441.text: Traveler. You are one who has witnessed much of the culinary world. When the day comes, one would be most pleased to see you in attendance, offering your most vociferous ovations.

400141443.text: Hmph. That which is implicitly understood needs not be made explicit, let alone official.

400141444.text: I shall say no more, and dwell here no longer. Await my word! Be there or beware!

400141445.text: This bird always disappears just as quickly as she shows up. Wait, not bird — adeptus! ...Hey, wait, isn't she technically an illuminated bird, though...?

400141446.text: She seemed like someone very prestigious, and very talented at cooking.

400141447.text: She definitely, definitely loves her food.

400141448.text: What are you all huddled together over here for? The adeptus left already.

400141450.text: Sorry I kept you waiting. Xiangling, this is the recipe from my grandfather's notes. They're not in the best condition, so rather than bring them out of the house, I just transcribed the recipe.

400141451.text: Unfortunately, the texts my grandfather worked with were very old — usually faded, damaged, or both. Some parts are missing from this recipe, too. Do you think you'll still be able to work with it?

400141452.text: Oh, okay! Lemme take a look... Hmm... Mm-hmm... Mm, mm.

400141453.text: Gimme some time, I need to look into it!

400141706.text: Master, how are you keeping these days? Are you well?

400141707.text: Very well, thank you. What a surprise it is that you all had the time to come and visit me today.

400141710.text: Master, we came here because we have a question for you. Do you know about the Stove God?

400141711.text: Of course I know the Stove God.

400141712.text: Does this mean... you know them personally?

400141713.text: Ah, I see... it's the Moonchase Festival, isn't it.

400141714.text: How interesting... Haha, so, you came to hear some stories about the Stove God?

400141715.text: That's right, we're investigating something that happened recently.

400141716.text: I see... The great stone surfaces, and so you open an investigation. Hehe.

400141717.text: I must commend your guesswork this far. I did indeed know the Stove God of whom you speak. But it was a great many years ago.

400141718.text: Moonchase was originally a rite observed by the adepti — not something in which the ordinary people of Liyue would ever partake. But over the years they have sought to emulate it for themselves many times, giving rise to various festivals bearing the Moonchase name.

400141719.text: On nights when the moon shone bright, everybody would get together for joyful reunions. There would be fine food, fine wines, and choice teas.

400141720.text: Later, Rex Lapis unified all of these various festivals under the Moonchase name, to honor an old friend of his. In short, the heavens were our witness as we vowed to the moon to come together in joyful solidarity, to remember the past and reflect upon the present. That is the meaning of the Moonchase Festival.

400141722.text: Hehe... That friend made many contributions to Liyue, and Rex Lapis would not have them go unrecognized. Turning this season into a commemoration of his old friend was also a way to honor that friendship.

400141723.text: I can only presume that the Stove God Festival was one of the many subsumed into the Moonchase Festival.

400141724.text: In the hands of Rex Lapis, our nation's traditions were faithfully upheld... It is to their detriment that we must now be the ones to inherit this duty.

400141726.text: Oh, Keqing, I simply won't allow you to be so down on yourself. Nothing would delight Rex Lapis more than to know that those who follow in his footsteps continue to value these traditions and are working tirelessly to do them justice.

400141730.text: Lady Keqing, Lady Ningguang wishes to speak with you.

400141732.text: Must be important... Please excuse me, everyone. If I'm not back soon, you'll find me at Ningguang's office.

400141733.text: There she goes... Keqing's a lot more serious when she's got her work face on.

400141734.text: Do you want to know who Rex Lapis' friend was?

400141736.text: The Stove God is the friend, right?

400141737.text: Yes, precisely. There are few genuine coincidences in the world... the story of the lost festival and the old friend are indeed one and the same.

400141738.text: The Stove God was a good friend of mine too. What a pity it is that the god is now gone both from the world and from people's memories.

400141740.text: It is to everyone's regret that the Stove God passed. But gods cannot be fully destroyed, and we made a pact to wait until the land became fruitful once more, for perhaps the Stove God would then return, albeit in a new form.

400141741.text: Really? ...Master, you must miss the Stove God a lot, right? From the way you talk about it all, it sounds like you were the best of friends.

400141742.text: Yes, thinking back on it all, there are many fond memories.

400141743.text: I'm pleasantly surprised to find that Keqing is investigating this. She is a tenacious child, and anything she sets her mind to, she will diligently pursue. It warms my heart, and makes me want to give her a helping hand.

400141744.text: Unfortunately, however, I cannot simply give her the answer, for the process is of great importance to her.

400141745.text: Keqing's grandfather once researched the Stove God, and now she follows in his footsteps... Since Keqing has inherited this conundrum, so too she must inherit the journey to its resolution.

400141747.text: Of course! I count all the people of Liyue among my good friends. I remember when he was the same age as Keqing is now.... Ah, so young. Hehe.

400141748.text: Grandparent and grandchild are definitely made from the same mold. Both diligent enough to take on anything, and bold enough to see it through to the end.

400141749.text: I like to think of Liyue as my own little potted plant. I've watched it grow and blossom, and it grows more beautiful all the time. In the blink of an eye, the buds of yesterday are in full bloom today... It's wonderful to see.

400141750.text: For new blossoms must bloom on the branches if the tree is to remain evergreen and ever young.

400141751.text: My dears, you are absolutely right to focus your investigation on the stone. It is, as you suppose, the lost Statue of the Stove God, and within it lie all the answers that you seek.

400141752.text: I should like to see the stone for myself, if you would lead me to it. Perhaps the truth will emerge even as we watch on.

400141901.text: Ah, you're all here! I was just about to send someone to fetch you.

400141902.text: Keqing, has the stone undergone any changes?

400141903.text: A crack has appeared in one corner. But we still can't tell what's inside.

400141904.text: What happened? Did someone chip it while no one else was looking?

400141905.text: More likely a natural occurrence. Our weapons have had no effect on it.

400141906.text: How would a "natural occurrence" crack it open?

400141907.text: This is because the Stove God draws power from the actions of the masses. The heat of a busy kitchen, the joy of a reunion... Haha, keep up the good work and the truth will rise to the surface soon enough.

400141908.text: All the books say that the Stove God is the deity of food. So is this stone opening up because everyone's cooking for the festival?

400141909.text: Statues draw power from their people... so if the Stove God has dominion over cooking, could it be that the passion people put into their cooking gives power to the Stove God?

400141910.text: Ningguang and I chose "Feast of the Bounteous Land" as this year's theme, and now every chef signed up for the competition is busy preparing... Paimon's theory is not an unreasonable one.

400141911.text: Plus, a lot of families have reunion feasts around this time. With everyone back home, the whole city's bustling with people, and that adds a lot to the festive atmosphere.

400141912.text: So if the stone cracked because Liyue started getting festive, that must mean that when the festive fever peaks, it'll bust right open! Right?

400141913.text: That's gotta be it! Right, Master?

400141914.text: Hahaha, well, we'll have to see then, won't we?

400141915.text: Okay. The fact that cooking is involved gives us a perfect opportunity.

400141916.text: The selections phase of Masterful Chefs will be held indoors and seen by only a few people, but the finals will be held outside, in public. Everyone who wants to will be able to come and watch it. The atmosphere will be incredibly lively, no question.

400141917.text: And when the finals end, boom! We'll get to see who the Stove God really is. Right?

400141919.text: Well I've already signed up, so I should be able to help!

400141920.text: Yes. For a chef as accomplished as yourself, getting to the finals should be a breeze.

400141921.text: All this talk of cooking competitions is making Paimon hungry... Ah, Paimon can't wait! It'd be great if Paimon could take a nap and then wake up when it's the finals!

400145001.text: If you find out anything interesting, you gotta come back and tell me about it!

400145101.text: Food and medicine are inextricably intertwined, you know. To give a full account of all the ways in which they are connected, why, I'd have to start that story from a long, long way back...

400145201.text: Coconut milk... Now I want coconut milk.

400145301.text: Sincerely, Beidou, you misunderstand me. I have many simple pleasures — I take a stroll through Yujing Terrace and one down by the harbor every single day.

400145302.text: Ha. Well, everyone has their way of procrastinating, I guess.

400145401.text: Now, which book to read today? Aha, how about this — Chongyun, pick a book, any book, and read it out loud to me, will you? That way, I can give my mind a rest.

400145402.text: Huh? Um, that's why you brought me along?

400145403.text: Don't like that plan? Okay, then I'll read one for you. Hmm... how about "Young and Hopelessly Smitten"?

400145404.text: Xingqiu, don't you think you have one too many frivolous books in your collection...

400145405.text: Okay... "A Guide to Getting Ahead in Yujing Terrace." How about this one, then?

400145503.text: Whew... This book is pretty complicated...

400145601.text: Alright, show me how it's done!

400149901.text: You know, this is starting to feel like chili pepper weather. Mmm, Paimon's hungry for some fresh and fiery spicy food that let your taste buds have a blast!

400149902.text: #And if there's one dish that fits the bill, it's Black-Back Perch Stew! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's pay a visit to Wanmin Restaurant!

400149904.text: Hmm? It came from that direction. Come on!
